summary: Monarch Casino & Resort Inc filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 financial results and declaring a $0.30 per share cash dividend. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement; there is no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, or other special situation. The filing is a standard current report under Items 2.02 and 8.01. No deal terms are applicable.
